extraFacts.fact: The O-ring face seal (ORFS, SAE J1453 / ISO 8434-3) uses a flat-faced male end whose face carries an O-ring, sealed against the flat face of a female swivel nut; the thread holds the joint and the O-ring seals.
SAE J1926 / ISO 11926 is the O-ring boss port: a straight UN/UNF thread with an O-ring under the hex shoulder that makes the seal.
ASME B1.20.1 covers NPT taper pipe threads and ASME B1.20.3 covers Dryseal NPTF threads; both seal on the thread with sealant.
ISO 228-1 covers G (BSPP) parallel pipe threads, on which the joint is not made; the seal is a washer or O-ring.
The 37° JIC flare seats metal to metal on a 74° included cone; its standard is SAE J514 / ISO 8434-2.

faqs.q: Which standards does the Male Connector m ORFS X m SAE follow?
faqs.a: The listing names SAE J1453, ISO 8434-3 for the Male Connector m ORFS X m SAE. SAE J1453 / ISO 8434-3 is the O-ring face seal standard. SAE J1926 / ISO 11926 is the O-ring boss port standard. The listing states no certificate, so ask on your RFQ for a material certificate or test record and quote a part number such as IH-AD-ORFS-015-10.

faqs.q: What does the Male Connector m ORFS X m SAE connect to?
faqs.a: On the Male Connector m ORFS X m SAE, End A is an O-ring face seal (ORFS) male end, whose flat face carries the O-ring that seals against a female ORFS swivel nut. End B is an SAE O-ring boss male end (SAE J1926 / ISO 11926) that screws into a boss port and seals on the O-ring under the hex. More mating parts are in the [ORFS adapters](/c/orfs-adapters) and the [O-rings for ORB and ORFS adapters](/c/adapter-o-rings), and the [ORFS and ORB adapters guide](/blog/orfs-and-orb-adapters-guide) explains the sizes.

faqs.q: How do I install the Male Connector m ORFS X m SAE so it seals?
faqs.a: To fit the Male Connector m ORFS X m SAE, check that the O-ring in the flat face of the male ORFS end is present and clean, bring the flat faces square and tighten the swivel nut to the figure in the [make-up torque guide](/blog/hydraulic-fitting-make-up-torque). The O-ring seals, so a nicked face or a missing O-ring leaks. Fit the ORB end with its own O-ring.

faqs.q: Where is the Male Connector m ORFS X m SAE used?
